## What happened

Describe the expected behavior and what you observed.

## Reproduce

Provide steps and a minimal synthetic example. Include the error code and failed
step when available. Do not retry an uncertain submission just to collect evidence.

## Environment

- Hermo commit:
- OS and Node.js version:
- Chrome and companion version:
- Execution mode: connected Chrome or isolated retrieval

## Diagnostics

Share sanitized logs or screenshots only. Remove keys, personal information and
website content you cannot share. Report suspected vulnerabilities through
SECURITY.md instead of a public issue.
